channel.description: Recent content in Work Projects on

item.title: Safety Message Drafting Acceleration - Boeing
item.description: Developed a RAG-based system at Boeing to reduce flow time for drafting safety messages, using structured JSON schema output and hallucination detection to ensure reliable, grounded generation.

item.title: Domain-Specific RAG Pipeline - Boeing
item.description: Built a production-grade RAG pipeline for aerospace maintenance documentation at Boeing, combining dense vector search with BM25 retrieval and a domain-specific semantic layer to support operations analysts.

item.title: NLP Model Optimization & A/B Testing - Vennify
item.description: Conducted comprehensive A/B testing of NLP deployment optimizations, achieving significant latency improvements and cost reductions. Engineered dynamic programming batching solution that reduced training time by 30% while maintaining model accuracy.

item.title: NER Pipeline Modernization - Boeing
item.description: Migrated a legacy rule-based Named Entity Recognition pipeline to a SOTA transformer-based model at Boeing, eliminating an EOL dependency while preserving domain-specific accuracy on aerospace maintenance documentation.

item.title: Unified Authentication & Infrastructure Modernization - Boeing
item.description: Configured OpenLDAP and Samba to provide unified authentication across Windows and Linux systems for a lab environment on an isolated network, as a contractor supporting Boeing Oklahoma City.

item.title: VPS Migrations & Client Infrastructure - Quadranet
item.description: Performed live and cold VPS migrations between physical hosts for hosted client infrastructure at Quadranet, a managed hosting provider, minimizing downtime and maintaining service continuity.
